items.title: Har site ka morning status call
items.detail: Har site supervisor se 10 baje tak call/WhatsApp par aaj ka plan lo: kitni teams, kis elevation par, kitne panel/glass fix honge.

items.title: Kal ka actual vs plan check
items.detail: Kal ka plan aur actual output (sqm / nos) compare karo. Gap ho to reason likhwao - material, manpower, access ya client hold.

items.title: Manpower attendance
items.detail: Contractor wise labour count le lo (fitter, helper, sealant man). Isi count se labour bill verify hoga, isliye roz record rakho.

items.title: Material receipt entry
items.detail: Aaj site par jo material aaya (profile, glass, ACP, bracket, hardware) uska DC/invoice no. ke saath data-entry person se entry karwao.

items.title: Hindrance / hold-up note
items.detail: Agar client side se koi rukawat aayi (scaffold, power, access, drawing, glass) to usi din hindrance register me date-time ke saath likho.

items.title: Safety photo check
items.detail: Har site se ek photo mangao: harness, lifeline, scaffold tag. Bina photo ke kaam start nahi.

items.title: Site photos with date
items.detail: Progress photos elevation wise date stamp ke saath folder me save karwao. Billing aur EOT dono me kaam aate hain.

items.title: Pending decision follow-up
items.detail: Jo decisions client/architect se pending hain unka ek reminder roz bhejo (email par, sirf phone par nahi).

items.title: Crane / hoist / lift availability
items.detail: Kal ke kaam ke liye hoist, crane ya gondola ki booking confirm karo. Main contractor se written slot lo.

items.title: WhatsApp ka email follow-up
items.detail: Jo bhi important baat WhatsApp/phone par hui, uska short email same din bhejo - 'as discussed today...'. Yahi record baad me counter claim me kaam aata hai.

items.title: End of day summary
items.detail: Shaam ko 1 line per site summary banao: output, issue, kal ka plan. Ye weekly report ka base banega.

items.title: Cash requirement note
items.detail: Kis site par kal ke liye urgent payment / petty cash chahiye, note karke accounts ko bata do.

items.title: App me roz tick karo
items.detail: Is app me jo follow-up ho gaya uspe tick karo. Naye points aayenge to upar 'Naya kya hai' me yellow highlight dikhega.

items.title: Weekly progress report
items.detail: Har site ka weekly % progress (sqm done / total sqm) nikal ke boss ko bhejo. Same format har hafte rakho.

items.title: BOQ vs executed qty check
items.detail: Har item ka cumulative executed qty BOQ qty se compare karo. 90% cross ho to alert.

items.title: Material stock at site
items.detail: Site stock (glass, profile, ACP, silicone) ka physical count supervisor se mangwao aur system stock se milao.

items.title: Look-ahead plan 2 weeks
items.detail: Agle 2 hafte ka plan: kaun sa material chahiye, kaun si drawing, kitni teams. Isse purchase ko advance info milega.

items.title: Client meeting / MOM
items.detail: Weekly client meeting attend karo ya call karo. MOM khud draft karke 24 ghante me bhejo.

items.title: Pending approvals list
items.detail: Shop drawing, sample, mockup, variation - sabka pending list date ke saath client ko bhejo.

items.title: Contractor performance
items.detail: Contractor wise output per team per day dekho. Kam output wale ko warning ya extra team.

items.title: Receivables follow-up
items.detail: Kaun sa client bill kitne din se pending hai - list banao aur accounts/client ko follow up karo.

items.title: Team task review
items.detail: CAD aur data-entry person ke task list check karo: kya complete hua, kya pending, kya priority hai.

items.title: Site visit plan update
items.detail: Agle hafte kaun si site visit karni hai, car route ke hisab se plan karo (2-3 sites ek din me).

items.title: Snag / punch list update
items.detail: Har site ka open snag count update karo, handover wale area me zero snag target.

items.title: Risk list review
items.detail: Top 5 risk per site (glass delay, payment, drawing, manpower) review karo aur action owner fix karo.

items.title: Client RA bill submission
items.detail: Har mahine fixed date (jaise 25 tarikh) tak client RA bill submit karo: material receipt + installation + handover stage.

items.title: Contractor bill certification
items.detail: Contractor labour bills JMR ke basis par certify karo, BOQ qty cross nahi honi chahiye.

items.title: Material reconciliation
items.detail: Issued vs consumed vs wastage nikal ke theoretical consumption se compare karo. Wastage limit cross ho to reason.

items.title: Cash flow statement
items.detail: Mahine ka inflow (client payments) vs outflow (material, labour, overhead) site wise banao.

items.title: Variation register update
items.detail: Naye variation, approved, pending, rejected - sabka status aur value update karo.

items.title: Retention & advance recovery
items.detail: Client bill me advance recovery aur retention ka cumulative check karo. Galat deduction ho to object karo.

items.title: Debit note check
items.detail: Client ya main contractor ne koi debit note (electricity, water, damage, scaffold) lagaya ho to verify karo aur reply do.

items.title: Monthly MIS to boss
items.detail: Billing, collection, progress, pending decisions, risk - ek page ka MIS boss ko bhejo.

items.title: Insurance & labour compliance
items.detail: Contractor ka ESIC/PF/WC policy validity check karo. Expire ho to bill hold.

items.title: Budget vs actual cost
items.detail: Site wise budget cost vs actual cost compare karo. Margin gir raha ho to early bata do.

items.title: GST invoice check
items.detail: Client bill ka tax invoice, HSN/SAC, GST rate aur e-invoice sahi hai ya nahi, accounts ke saath confirm karo.

items.title: BOQ master sheet banao
items.detail: Har site ka BOQ item code, description, unit, qty, rate, amount ek master sheet me rakho. Yahi single source hoga.

items.title: BOQ vs drawing qty
items.detail: Approved shop drawing se qty nikal ke BOQ se compare karo. Difference = possible variation.

items.title: Item wise executed qty
items.detail: Har item ka executed qty JMR ke basis par update karo, estimate par nahi.

items.title: Balance qty alert
items.detail: Balance qty 10% se kam ho jaye to boss aur client dono ko bata do - extra qty ke liye amendment chahiye.

items.title: Non-BOQ items identify
items.detail: Jo kaam BOQ me nahi hai (extra bracket, extra flashing, sill, coping) unko turant extra item list me dalo.

items.title: Unit consistency
items.detail: sqm, rmt, nos, kg - BOQ unit aur measurement unit same ho. Glass sqm me, profile kg/rmt me ho sakta hai, confusion avoid karo.

items.title: Rate analysis ready rakho
items.detail: Har major item ka rate analysis (material + labour + overhead) ready rakho, new item rate claim me kaam aayega.

items.title: Over-run items
items.detail: Jo item BOQ qty cross kar chuke, unki list banao aur amendment request bhejo, kaam continue karne se pehle written approval lo.

items.title: Provisional sum items
items.detail: PC/provisional items ka actual cost record rakho, final adjustment me chahiye.

items.title: BOQ freeze copy
items.detail: Contract wala original BOQ PDF signed copy alag folder me rakho, koi edit nahi.

items.title: Area statement
items.detail: Elevation wise facade area statement (sqm) CAD person se banwa lo, glazing/ACP/louver alag.

items.title: Variation ka trigger pakdo
items.detail: Drawing revision, client instruction, site condition change - har ek possible variation hai. Same din note karo.

items.title: Written instruction lo
items.detail: Client/architect ki verbal instruction par kaam mat karo. Email/RFI/site instruction me written lo.

items.title: Variation register
items.detail: VO no., date, description, reference (email/MOM), qty, rate, amount, status - sab ek register me.

items.title: Variation proposal 7 din me
items.detail: Instruction milne ke 7 din me cost + time impact ke saath variation proposal bhejo, late hua to claim weak hota hai.

items.title: Time impact bhi likho
items.detail: Variation me sirf paisa nahi, kitne din extra lagenge wo bhi likho - EOT ke liye zaroori.

items.title: Extra material list
items.detail: Extra material (bracket, profile, glass size change) ki qty aur rate supplier quote ke saath attach karo.

items.title: Rate basis
items.detail: New item rate: pehle BOQ ke similar item ka rate, nahi to market rate + overhead. Basis clearly likho.

items.title: Approval follow-up
items.detail: Pending variation ka 15 din me approval nahi aaya to reminder letter, 30 din par escalation.

items.title: Amendment order
items.detail: Approved variations ko PO amendment / work order amendment me convert karwao, warna billing nahi hogi.

items.title: Omissions bhi track karo
items.detail: Jo item client ne hataye unki bhi list rakho, profit loss aur material return plan karo.

items.title: Variation billing
items.detail: Approved variation ka bill alag line item me lagao, main BOQ me mix mat karo.

items.title: Stage 1 - Material receipt bill
items.detail: Site par material aane par DC, invoice, inspection report, photos ke saath material stage bill (jaise 60-70%) lagao.

items.title: Stage 2 - Installation bill
items.detail: Installed qty JMR (joint measurement) client engineer se sign karwa ke installation stage bill lagao.

items.title: Stage 3 - Handover bill
items.detail: Handover / testing / snag clear certificate ke baad final stage bill lagao.

items.title: Billing cut-off date
items.detail: Har mahine ek fixed cut-off date rakho (jaise 20 tarikh), uske baad wala kaam next bill me.

items.title: JMR sign time par
items.detail: JMR mahine ke end ka wait mat karo, weekly sign karwao taaki dispute kam ho.

items.title: Material inspection report
items.detail: Material receipt bill ke liye client ka MIR (material inspection request) sign karwa lo.

items.title: Bill tracking sheet
items.detail: Bill no, date, amount claimed, certified, paid, balance, days pending - sab track karo.

items.title: Certified vs claimed gap
items.detail: Client ne kam certify kiya to item wise reason likhwao aur next bill me re-claim karo.

items.title: Payment due date
items.detail: Contract ke payment terms (jaise 30/45 din) ke hisab se due date nikal ke follow up karo.

items.title: Escalation / price variation
items.detail: Contract me PVC clause ho to aluminium / glass rate escalation ka claim calculate karo.

items.title: Supporting docs set
items.detail: Har bill ke saath: abstract, measurement sheet, JMR, photos, DC copies, previous bill summary.

items.title: Final bill checklist
items.detail: Final bill se pehle: sab variation approved, retention release request, warranty submitted, NOC.

items.title: Stage wise bill tracker app me
items.detail: Har site ka material / installation / handover stage % ek line me rakho - kaunsa stage kitna bill hua, kitna baki.

items.title: Work order clear rakho
items.detail: Har contractor ka work order: scope, rate, unit, payment terms, retention, safety penalty - sab likhit.

items.title: JMR ke basis par bill
items.detail: Contractor bill sirf joint measurement par certify karo, contractor ke apne measurement par nahi.

items.title: BOQ qty limit
items.detail: Contractor ka cumulative qty client BOQ qty se zyada nahi hona chahiye. Zyada ho to variation approved hai ya nahi check karo.

items.title: Client billed vs contractor paid
items.detail: Jo qty client se bill hua usse zyada contractor ko pay nahi. Ye margin control ka sabse simple check hai.

items.title: Advance recovery
items.detail: Contractor ko diya advance har bill me % ke hisab se recover karo.

items.title: Material issued recovery
items.detail: Free issue material (silicone, screws, brackets) ki wastage limit cross ho to recovery lagao.

items.title: Retention
items.detail: Contractor bill se retention (jaise 5%) kaato, defect liability ke baad release.

items.title: Labour count vs output
items.detail: Labour attendance aur output compare karo - output kam aur labour zyada matlab productivity issue.

items.title: Daily wage / extra labour
items.detail: Extra daily-wage labour sirf written requisition par, daily sign attendance ke saath.

items.title: Safety penalty
items.detail: Bina harness kaam, PPE violation - work order ke hisab se penalty record karo.

items.title: Bill passing timeline
items.detail: Contractor bill 7 din me check karke forward karo, delay se site par labour issue hota hai.

items.title: Final settlement
items.detail: Contractor final bill: sab recovery, retention, material return, snag clearance ke baad.

items.title: Site wise cash flow
items.detail: Har site ka monthly inflow vs outflow plan banao, 3 mahine aage tak.

items.title: Billing forecast
items.detail: Agle mahine kitna bill lagega (stage wise) uska forecast boss ko do.

items.title: Collection follow-up
items.detail: Overdue bills ka list 30/60/90 din aging ke saath banao.

items.title: Payables planning
items.detail: Supplier aur contractor payments ka due list banao aur collection ke hisab se priority do.

items.title: Glass/material advance
items.detail: Bade material order ke advance ka cash impact pehle se plan karo.

items.title: Retention money tracking
items.detail: Har site ka retention held by client aur release date track karo.

items.title: Bank guarantee expiry
items.detail: Advance BG / performance BG ki expiry date 30 din pehle alert.

items.title: Negative cash sites
items.detail: Jis site par outflow > inflow ho, uske reason (billing late, extra work unbilled) boss ko batao.

items.title: Unbilled work
items.detail: Kaam ho gaya par bill nahi hua - is unbilled value ko har mahine zero ke paas lao.

items.title: Petty cash control
items.detail: Site petty cash ka voucher ke saath weekly settlement.

items.title: Aluminium profile requirement
items.detail: Shop drawing se profile wise cutting list aur kg requirement CAD person se nikalwao.

items.title: Glass schedule
items.detail: Glass type, size, qty, location code ke saath glass schedule banao - order aur delivery tracking isi se.

items.title: ACP requirement
items.detail: ACP sheet size optimisation karke order karo, wastage 10-12% se zyada nahi.

items.title: Hardware list
items.detail: Openable windows/doors ka hardware (hinges, friction stay, handle, lock, closer) qty-wise list.

items.title: Silicone & sealant
items.detail: Structural silicone aur weather sealant ka consumption per rmt se requirement, expiry date check.

items.title: Brackets & anchors
items.detail: Bracket, anchor fastener, embedded plate ki qty floor/elevation wise.

items.title: Material delivery schedule
items.detail: Supplier se delivery schedule lo aur site plan ke saath match karo.

items.title: GRN / receipt check
items.detail: Site par material aate hi qty, damage, size check karke GRN banao. Damage ho to photo + DC par remark.

items.title: Site storage
items.detail: Glass A-frame par, profile rack par, ACP flat - galat storage se breakage aur scratch.

items.title: Material issue register
items.detail: Contractor ko jo material issue ho uska issue slip aur register.

items.title: Monthly reconciliation
items.detail: Received - issued - balance stock - installed = wastage. Theoretical vs actual compare.

items.title: Surplus / return
items.detail: Site close hone par surplus material ki list banao aur dusri site par transfer karo.

items.title: Breakage record
items.detail: Glass breakage ka reason (handling, site, manufacturing) ke saath record - replacement cost kis par.

items.title: Glass ka scope clear karo
items.detail: Glass kiske scope me hai (client supply ya hamara) contract se confirm karo. Client scope ho to delivery delay client ka risk.

items.title: Final size list
items.detail: Site measurement ke baad final glass size list approve karwa ke hi order do.

items.title: Order date record
items.detail: Glass order / client final order ki date likho - delivery period (jaise 12 din) usi se count hoga.

items.title: Delivery tracking
items.detail: Lot wise: order date, promised date, actual date, qty, short / damaged.

items.title: Delay ka record
items.detail: Glass late aaya to har lot ka delay days nikal ke client ko letter do (agar client scope).

items.title: Breakage replacement
items.detail: Broken glass ka replacement order turant do, size list update karo.

items.title: Glass inspection
items.detail: Coating side, edge damage, scratch, size tolerance, stamp - delivery par check.

items.title: Unloading plan
items.detail: Glass unloading ke liye crane/manpower aur suction cups pehle se ready.

items.title: Installation rate
items.detail: Team wise per day glass fixing (jaise 35 glass/team/day) track karo, isse delay analysis me help.

items.title: Shortfall report
items.detail: Kaun se location ke glass pending hain uski list weekly client ko.

items.title: Shop drawing submission plan
items.detail: Kaun si drawing kab submit hogi uska schedule banao aur client ko bhejo.

items.title: Drawing register
items.detail: Drawing no., revision, submission date, status (A/B/C), approval date - register me.

items.title: Approval ke din count
items.detail: Submission ke baad approval me kitne din lage, track karo - delay claim me kaam aata hai.

items.title: Revision ka impact
items.detail: Har revision par check: qty change, material already ordered, rework - variation banta hai kya.

items.title: Structural calculation
items.detail: Wind load, bracket, anchor calculation approval ke saath submit karo.

items.title: Sample approval
items.detail: Glass, ACP colour, profile finish, hardware sample ka written approval.

items.title: Mock-up approval
items.detail: Mock-up panel bana ke client se sign-off lo, uske baad bulk production.

items.title: As-built drawings
items.detail: Kaam ke saath as-built mark-up chalate raho, end me CAD person final banaye.

items.title: CAD person ka task list
items.detail: CAD person ko weekly priority list do: shop drawing, area statement, as-built, cutting list.

items.title: Latest revision at site
items.detail: Site par sirf latest approved revision ho, purani drawing hatao.

items.title: Decision log
items.detail: Har pending decision: kya, kisse, kab manga, kab chahiye, kitne din se pending, impact.

items.title: Need-by date do
items.detail: Request me clearly likho 'decision required by DD/MM, warna X area ka kaam rukega'.

items.title: Reminder sequence
items.detail: Day 0 request, Day 7 reminder, Day 14 letter, Day 21 escalation to senior.

items.title: Impact statement
items.detail: Pending decision se kitni qty / kitna bill / kitne din ruke, number me likho.

items.title: Hold area mark karo
items.detail: Drawing par hold area mark karke client ko bhejo - billing aur progress me clear rahega.

items.title: Bills stuck due to decision
items.detail: Decision na hone se jo bill nahi lag raha uski value boss ko monthly batao.

items.title: MOM me record
items.detail: Har meeting me pending decisions ka agenda item rakho, MOM me client ka commitment date likho.

items.title: Alternate proposal
items.detail: Decision delay ho raha ho to 2 options cost ke saath de do, client ko choose karna easy hota hai.

items.title: Clearance date record
items.detail: Jis din client ne area / decision clear kiya, wo date bhi written me lo - delay end date wahi hai.

items.title: Escalation letter
items.detail: 30 din se zyada pending ho to formal letter with contract clause reference.

items.title: Hindrance register
items.detail: Har hindrance: start date, end date, reason, affected area, signed by client engineer.

items.title: Rain / power failure record
items.detail: Rain aur power failure ke din aur ghante likho, site photo ke saath.

items.title: Scaffold / access delay
items.detail: Main contractor ka scaffold, access, front available nahi to written record.

items.title: Delay notice time par
items.detail: Contract me jitne din me notice dena hai (jaise 7/14 din), usme notice bhejo.

items.title: Delay events ko overlap mat karo
items.detail: EOT me same period ke 2 reason ko jod ke double count mat karo - longest path lo.

items.title: Productivity basis
items.detail: Per day output (jaise 35 glass/team/day x 3 teams) ke basis par lost days calculate karo.

items.title: Penalty clause samjho
items.detail: LD clause: % per week/month, cap (max 5-10%), base value (glass excluded ya nahi).

items.title: EOT application
items.detail: Delay khatam hote hi EOT application: events, days, documents, revised completion date.

items.title: Counter claim ready rakho
items.detail: Client penalty lagaye to counter: unke scope ka delay (glass, decision, access) document ke saath.

items.title: Revised programme
items.detail: Har major delay ke baad revised schedule submit karo aur client acceptance lo.

items.title: Prolongation cost
items.detail: Delay se extra site overhead, staff, scaffold rent, idle labour ka cost bhi claim karo.

items.title: Without prejudice
items.detail: Penalty / claim letter me 'without prejudice to our rights' zaroor likho.

items.title: Penalty se pehle clause ka base check
items.detail: Client penalty lagaye to dekho base value kya hai - total order ya glass excluded order value. Satya type sites me glass client scope tha to glass value base me nahi aani chahiye.

items.title: Roles clear karo
items.detail: CAD: drawings, area, as-built, cutting list. Data entry: receipts, bills, registers, MIS. Written list do.

items.title: Daily task sheet
items.detail: Dono ko subah task list, shaam ko status. Simple Excel ya WhatsApp list.

items.title: Standard formats
items.detail: Saare register ka ek hi format sab sites par - data entry fast aur error kam.

items.title: Folder structure
items.detail: Site > Drawings / Bills / JMR / DC / Photos / Letters / MOM - same structure sab sites ke liye.

items.title: Data backup
items.detail: Har week data ka backup (OneDrive / pen drive).

items.title: Cross check
items.detail: Data entry ka 10% random sample khud check karo.

items.title: Skill training
items.detail: CAD person ko area calc aur quantity take-off sikhao, data entry ko Excel formulas.

items.title: Site manpower plan
items.detail: Har site ka required teams vs actual teams weekly compare karo.

items.title: Leave planning
items.detail: Team ki chutti pehle se plan, billing week me chutti avoid.

items.title: Delegation
items.detail: Routine follow-up (DC collect, photo collect) team ko do, khud decision aur client wala kaam karo.

items.title: Full body harness
items.detail: Height par kaam bina double lanyard harness ke nahi. Daily check.

items.title: Lifeline
items.detail: Har working zone me lifeline fixed aur inspected ho.

items.title: Scaffold tag
items.detail: Scaffold par green tag (inspected) ho tabhi use. Red tag = no work.

items.title: Gondola / BMU check
items.detail: Gondola ka load test certificate, daily check list, trained operator.

items.title: Toolbox talk
items.detail: Har subah 10 min toolbox talk, attendance sheet sign.

items.title: Glass handling
items.detail: Suction cup, gloves, 2 aadmi per glass, wind speed zyada ho to lifting band.

items.title: Barricading
items.detail: Neeche working zone barricade aur 'men at work above' board.

items.title: PPE stock
items.detail: Helmet, shoes, gloves, goggles ka stock site par.

items.title: Work permit
items.detail: Height work, hot work (welding) ke liye permit system.

items.title: Incident report
items.detail: Near miss / accident ka same din report aur root cause.

items.title: Labour induction
items.detail: Naye labour ka safety induction aur ID card.

items.title: Inspection test plan (ITP)
items.detail: Har activity ka ITP: bracket, frame, glass, sealant, ACP - hold points ke saath.

items.title: Bracket installation check
items.detail: Line, level, anchor torque, bracket spacing drawing ke hisab se.

items.title: Anchor pull-out test
items.detail: Anchor fastener ka pull-out test client ki presence me, report sign.

items.title: Frame alignment
items.detail: Mullion plumb, transom level, joint gap tolerance check.

items.title: Silicone adhesion test
items.detail: Structural silicone ka peel / adhesion test aur cure time record.

items.title: Water test
items.detail: Window/curtain wall ka hose test (AAMA 501.2 type) area wise, report client se sign.

items.title: Glass checking
items.detail: Glass ka scratch, chip, coating side, label after installation.

items.title: ACP joints
items.detail: ACP groove, joint width, sealant finish, protective film timing.

items.title: Fire stop
items.detail: Floor slab edge par fire stop (mineral wool + sealant) inspection.

items.title: Material test certificates
items.detail: Aluminium (alloy, coating thickness), glass, silicone ke test certificates file me.

items.title: NCR tracking
items.detail: Non-conformance report ka register, closure date ke saath.

items.title: Coating thickness
items.detail: Powder coating / anodising thickness DFT gauge se random check.

items.title: Area wise handover
items.detail: Pura building wait mat karo, floor / elevation wise handover lo.

items.title: Snag list joint walk
items.detail: Client ke saath joint walk karke snag list sign karo, uske bahar naye snag na aaye.

items.title: Cleaning
items.detail: Final glass cleaning, protective film removal, debris clear.

items.title: Handover certificate
items.detail: Area handover certificate client se sign - stage 3 billing isi se.

items.title: Warranty documents
items.detail: Glass, silicone, hardware, coating, system warranty - client format me.

items.title: O&M manual
items.detail: Operation & maintenance manual: cleaning, hardware adjustment, sealant inspection.

items.title: As-built set
items.detail: Final as-built drawings PDF + CAD submit.

items.title: Test reports file
items.detail: Saari test reports (water, pull-out, adhesion) ek file me.

items.title: Keys & hardware
items.detail: Door keys, spare hardware list ke saath handover.

items.title: Retention release request
items.detail: Defect liability period khatam hote hi retention release letter.

items.title: Completion certificate
items.detail: Final completion / virtual completion certificate lo - penalty period yahi band karta hai.

items.title: Vendor list
items.detail: Har material ka 2-3 approved vendor ka contact, rate, lead time list.

items.title: PO status
items.detail: PO date, delivery date, qty received, balance - weekly update.

items.title: Lead time track
items.detail: Aluminium extrusion, glass, ACP, hardware ka current lead time pata rakho.

items.title: Quality complaint
items.detail: Defective material ka written complaint photo ke saath, replacement date lo.

items.title: Rate comparison
items.detail: Bada order dene se pehle 3 quote compare.

items.title: Supplier payment status
items.detail: Supplier ka payment pending ho to delivery atak sakti hai - accounts ke saath check.

items.title: Transport
items.detail: Glass / long profile ke liye proper vehicle aur unloading ka time.

items.title: Vendor documents
items.detail: Test certificate, warranty, invoice, e-way bill har delivery ke saath.

items.title: Agenda pehle bhejo
items.detail: Meeting se ek din pehle agenda: progress, pending decisions, bills, issues.

items.title: MOM khud likho
items.detail: MOM aap draft karoge to aapke points record me aayenge.

items.title: Action owner + date
items.detail: Har point par kaun karega aur kab tak - naam aur date.

items.title: MOM 24 ghante me
items.detail: MOM 24 ghante me email karo, 'comments within 3 days else treated as accepted'.

items.title: Previous MOM review
items.detail: Har meeting ki shuruat pichle MOM ke open points se.

items.title: Numbers ke saath jao
items.detail: Meeting me sqm, nos, amount, days - figures ke saath baat karo.

items.title: Internal review
items.detail: Boss ke saath monthly internal review: margin, cash, risk.

items.title: One page MIS
items.detail: Saari sites ek page: progress %, billed, collected, pending decisions, risk. Simple table.

items.title: Weekly short update
items.detail: Har site 2-3 line: kya hua, kya ruka, kya chahiye.

items.title: Exception reporting
items.detail: Sirf problem wali cheezein highlight karo - sab theek wala short me.

items.title: Same format har baar
items.detail: Report ka format change mat karo, boss ko compare karna easy.

items.title: Plain look
items.detail: Report simple rakho: table, borders, grey header. Number sahi ho, design nahi.

items.title: Billing vs target
items.detail: Monthly billing target vs actual site wise.

items.title: Cash position
items.detail: Receivable aur payable ka net position.

items.title: Issues needing boss help
items.detail: Jaha boss ka call / letter chahiye wo alag likho.

items.title: Progress %
items.detail: Progress % = installed sqm / total facade sqm x 100. Example: 3300/6600 = 50%.

items.title: Glass days required
items.detail: Days = balance glass nos / (teams x glass per team per day). Example: 2100/(3x35) = 20 din.

items.title: Penalty amount
items.detail: Penalty = order value (as per clause, glass excluded ho to minus karo) x % x delay months. Cap check karo.

items.title: Material stage bill
items.detail: Material bill = qty received x rate x material stage % (jaise 60%).

items.title: Wastage %
items.detail: Wastage % = (issued - installed) / issued x 100. ACP ~10%, profile ~3-5%, silicone ~10%.

items.title: Aluminium kg
items.detail: Profile kg = length (m) x unit weight (kg/m). Unit weight die drawing se.

items.title: Silicone consumption
items.detail: 1 sausage (600ml) approx 6 rmt @ 10x10 mm joint. Joint volume se calculate.

items.title: Margin check
items.detail: Margin = (client rate - material - labour - overhead) / client rate. Har variation item ka bhi.

items.title: Retention
items.detail: Retention = bill value x retention % (jaise 5%), cap (jaise 5% of contract) check.

items.title: Aging
items.detail: Days pending = today - bill submission date. 30/60/90 bucket.

items.title: EOT longest path
items.detail: EOT = sabse lamba non-overlapping delay path, saare delays ka sum nahi.

items.name: Facade systems ki samajh
items.why: Unitised, semi-unitised, stick glazing, ACP, spider, windows/doors - har system ka sequence, cost aur risk alag hai.
items.how: Har site par ek system ka installation sequence khud dekho, supplier ke system catalogue padho.

items.name: Drawing reading
items.why: Shop drawing, elevation, section, detail padh ke qty aur issue pakadna PM ka base skill hai.
items.how: Roz ek drawing CAD person ke saath khol ke elevation se area aur section se bracket count nikalo.

items.name: BOQ & quantity estimation
items.why: Billing, variation, contractor bill sab BOQ qty par chalta hai.
items.how: Ek elevation ka khud take-off karo aur CAD wale area se compare karo.

items.name: Measurement / JMR
items.why: Jo naapa wahi bill hota hai. Galat JMR = paisa ka loss.
items.how: Client engineer ke saath 2-3 JMR khud karo, measurement rules (opening deduction, unit) likh ke rakho.

items.name: Contract & clauses
items.why: Payment terms, LD/penalty, EOT, variation, retention clauses se hi claim aur defence banta hai.
items.how: Har site ke contract ka 1 page summary banao: scope, payment, penalty, EOT, retention.

items.name: Client billing (stage wise)
items.why: Material, installation, handover - teeno stage time par lagenge to cash flow theek rahega.
items.how: Har mahine ka bill khud check karo: qty x rate x stage %, supporting docs ke saath.

items.name: Contractor bill checking
items.why: Contractor ko client se zyada qty pay ho gayi to margin khatam.
items.how: Har bill par 3 check: JMR qty, BOQ limit, client billed qty.

items.name: Cash flow planning
items.why: 10 sites me kahin paisa atka to kaam rukta hai.
items.how: Site wise 3 mahine ka inflow-outflow sheet roz update ki aadat banao.

items.name: Variation & claim preparation
items.why: Extra kaam ka paisa tabhi milega jab time par written claim jaaye.
items.how: Har instruction par 7 din me cost + time impact ka 1 page proposal banane ki practice.

items.name: Excel (practical)
items.why: Saare registers, MIS, reconciliation Excel me hote hain.
items.how: SUMIFS, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, IF, data validation dropdown, pivot table, conditional formatting seekho - 15 min roz.

items.name: Planning & scheduling
items.why: Glass, material, manpower, approvals ko ek timeline me jodna padta hai.
items.how: Har site ka 2 hafte ka look-ahead plan banao aur Friday ko actual se compare karo.

items.name: Follow-up discipline
items.why: Facade me 80% delay follow-up miss hone se hota hai.
items.how: Ek follow-up list roz subah dekho, har point par next date likho.

items.name: Team handling (CAD + data entry)
items.why: Do log hi hain, unka output hi aapka output hai.
items.how: Roz subah 10 min task brief, shaam ko 5 min status. Clear format do.

items.name: Letter / email writing
items.why: Written record hi claim, EOT aur penalty defence ka saboot hai.
items.how: Standard templates banao: reminder, hindrance notice, variation, EOT, escalation. Short aur fact based likho.

items.name: MOM writing
items.why: Jo MOM likhta hai uski baat record me jaati hai.
items.how: Har meeting ka MOM khud draft karo: point, action by, target date.

items.name: Client / architect communication
items.why: Decision jaldi lene ke liye clear options aur impact batana padta hai.
items.how: Har request me: kya chahiye, kab tak, nahi mila to kya impact - 3 line format.

items.name: Contract clause se counter karna
items.why: Client penalty ya debit note lagaye to clause aur record ke saath counter karna PM ka sabse kaam ka skill hai.
items.how: Ek purane case (jaise Satya 3 EOT) ko clause, dates aur letters ke saath 1 page me likh ke practice karo.

items.name: AutoCAD basics
items.why: Drawing me khud measure, area check, markup kar sakoge - CAD person par depend kam.
items.how: DIST, AREA, LAYER, dimension, PDF markup seekho - YouTube + 30 min practice roz.

items.name: QA/QC & testing knowledge
items.why: Water test, pull-out, silicone adhesion fail hue to handover aur billing rukta hai.
items.how: Har test ek baar khud attend karo, ITP aur test report format samjho.

items.name: Material knowledge
items.why: Aluminium alloy, glass types (DGU, laminated, toughened), ACP FR, silicone - sahi spec aur rate samajhna.
items.how: Supplier se technical data sheet mangao aur 1 page notes banao.

items.name: Structural basics
items.why: Wind load, bracket, anchor - safety aur approval ke liye basic samajh chahiye.
items.how: Structural calc report ka summary page padhna seekho.

items.name: Rate analysis
items.why: New item aur variation rate justify karne ke liye.
items.how: Ek item ka material + labour + overhead + profit breakup banao.

items.name: Delay analysis / EOT
items.why: Penalty se bachne aur EOT lene ke liye.
items.how: Hindrance register se ek site ka delay path banake practice karo.

items.name: Cost control
items.why: Budget vs actual dekh ke margin bachana.
items.how: Har mahine site wise budget vs actual 1 sheet.

items.name: Negotiation
items.why: Client se rate, time, payment aur contractor se rate - dono taraf negotiation.
items.how: Pehle apna minimum aur target likho, data ke saath baat karo, 'win-win' option rakho.

items.name: Prioritisation
items.why: 10 sites par sab kuch ek saath nahi ho sakta.
items.how: Har subah top 3 kaam chuno: paisa, delay, safety.

items.name: Risk management
items.why: Problem aane se pehle pakadna sasta padta hai.
items.how: Har site ke top 5 risk aur unka action weekly review.

items.name: Site visit planning
items.why: Car aur time ka best use.
items.how: Route wise 2-3 sites ek din, har visit ka checklist.

items.name: Safety leadership
items.why: Ek accident poori site rok deta hai.
items.how: Har visit par 5 min safety walk aur feedback.

items.name: Time management
items.why: Calls, meetings, billing ke beech khud ka time bachana.
items.how: Billing aur reports ke liye fixed time block calendar me rakho.

items.name: Calm under pressure
items.why: Client, boss, contractor - sab ek saath pressure dete hain.
items.how: Pehle facts collect karo, phir jawab do. Gusse me mail mat bhejo.

items.name: Relationship building
items.why: Client engineer aur architect se acche relation se approval aur JMR fast hote hain.
items.how: Regular short visits, time par commitment pura karna.

items.name: Presentation to boss
items.why: Boss ko short aur numbers ke saath batana.
items.how: Har update: 1 line status, 1 line issue, 1 line help chahiye.

items.name: Learning habit
items.why: Naye systems aur rules aate rehte hain.
items.how: Hafte me 1 cheez naya seekho - is app ka 'Naya kya hai' dekhte raho.
